opinions.text: C. A. 6th Cir. (Certiorari granted, 381 U. S. 923.) The motion of Schnell Tool & Die Corp. et al. is granted insofar as permission to file a brief, as amici curiae, is requested, and is denied insofar as permission to participate in oral argument is requested.
